name: testland/pytest-asyncio-patterns
description: Use when async Python tests are skipped or fail with event-loop errors, or when testing FastAPI or aiohttp endpoints: configures pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode auto vs strict, event-loop scope), async fixtures with @pytest_asyncio.fixture, AsyncMock for coroutines, httpx.AsyncClient with ASGITransport, and the aiohttp_client fixture. Not for general fixture, parametrize or conftest.py design without an asyncio problem: use python-unit-tests.
